name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter's motorsport journey began with a fascination for engineering and a deep-seated competitive spirit. After graduating with honors in mechanical engineering from Budapest University of Technology and Economics, she quickly found her way into Formula Student, leading her team to several national championships. This experience ignited her passion for the high-pressure environment of racing.

Following Formula Student, Eszter joined a small GT racing team, starting as a data analyst and quickly rising to become a race engineer. Her methodical approach and sharp decision-making caught the attention of Signature Racing, who recruited her as an engineering strategist. She excelled in this role, consistently improving the team's race performance through innovative strategies and data-driven insights. Eszter became the team principal after only a few years, due to her exceptional management skills and ability to foster a high-performance team environment.

Eszter's leadership style is characterized by her pragmatic approach and attention to detail. She demands excellence from her team and works tirelessly to ensure that every aspect of the operation is optimized for success. Her relentless pursuit of perfection and her ability to make tough decisions under pressure have earned her the respect of her peers and the admiration of her team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight, usually pulled back in a tight ponytail.
physical.description: Eszter is a slim woman with sharp, intelligent eyes and a focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a perfectly clean and organized desk at all times.
